# TurboWarp TM Extension ID Migration Fixture

The executable fixture is generated by `test/extension-id-migration.test.mjs` so this repository can
exercise the legacy source state without keeping pose-era branding in checked-in text files. The
fixture covers project extension IDs, opcode prefixes, embedded extension mappings, source lock and
integrity metadata, API manifest metadata, unrelated extensions, and deterministic SB3 rebuilds.
